context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 verified two new features: 1) Bulk Optimization - POST /api/surfer/bulk-optimize starts job to optimize all articles with score < threshold (default 60%). Status endpoint returns progress with per-article status (pending/optimizing/done/failed). Frontend ROI Dashboard shows 'Optymalizuj słabe (N)' button when weak articles exist, opens modal with progress UI. 2) WordPress Webhook - POST /api/wordpress/webhook/generate-token creates user token, GET /config returns webhook URL + token + setup instructions. Webhook receiver authenticates via X-Webhook-Token header, processes events: post_published (updates wp_post_id, wp_permalink, wp_status='published'), traffic_stats (updates wp_views_7d/30d, wp_comments), post_deleted (sets wp_status='deleted', reverts status to 'draft'). Frontend AdminSettings /admin/settings shows WebhookConfig section with URL/token fields and copy buttons. WP Preview tab in editor shows live-status card with views/comments when article is published on WP.
